name: Face to Face
description: Bjørn investigates the killing of his daughter. People around him believe she might have committed suicide, but he doesn't accept that. Both the stakes and the suspense rise relentlessly as Bjørn inches closer to the truth.

videos.title: Forensics
videos.overview: Investigator Bjorn is called to the morgue for an ordinary identification and is faced with a hard truth; the body belongs to his daughter. Although all clues point to a suicide, he fixates on a tiny clue that proves otherwise.

videos.title: The Apartment
videos.overview: Bjorn is led to a luxury apartment where he encounters an unknown young woman, who turns out to be his daughter’s wife. Soon, he starts piecing together the puzzle of his daughter’s life, and it is darker than he ever thought.

videos.title: The Brothel
videos.overview: Inspector Bjorn arrives at a luxury brothel to find the prostitute who introduced his daughter to prostitution. As he later finds out, they enjoyed together a sinful life crawling with parties, drugs, sex and fast money.

videos.title: The Nightclub
videos.overview: Bjorn meets with a notorious club owner, with whom he made shady deals in the past. He reveals shocking information about Bjorn’s daughter, and makes him face a harsh truth; his daughter was not the innocent girl he remembered.

videos.title: The Police car
videos.overview: The clues lead Bjorn to a corrupted cop he used to work with in the past. Although he tells him many lies, Bjorn knows that he met with his daughter the night she died, and he tries to cut through the lies to uncover a major clue.

videos.title: The Traveler's Course
videos.overview: The clues lead Bjorn to a corrupted cop he used to work with in the past. Although he tells him many lies, Bjorn knows that he met with his daughter the night she died, and he tries to cut through the lies to uncover a major clue.

videos.title: The Morgue
videos.overview: Finally convinced that his daughter committed suicide, Bjorn meets with his ex-wife to say their final goodbye to their child. But as they are mourning over the casket, Bjorn notices a small detail that could change everything...

videos.title: The Last Stop
videos.overview: Bjorn confronts the coroner, who tries to persuade him to seek for psychiatric help. But the detective has connected the dots, and is certain he now knows the truth. All he wants is revenge...

videos.title: The Private Clinic
videos.overview: Susanne mourns the loss of her daughter. When the doorbell rings, she is confronted by a man John, who wants help to stop smoking. During the hypnosis, John reveals something shocking.

videos.title: The Police Academy
videos.overview: Susanne seeks out Police Commissioner Richard to tell him about the mysterious man. Richard has no knowledge of the man or cases of murder of young women. But he asks Susanne for a favor.

videos.title: The Normal House
videos.overview: Susanne meets Officer Louise, who turns out to be a former client, whom she helped after a rape. When Susanne discovers that the police commissioner is calling Louise, she's sure something's wrong.

videos.title: The Prison
videos.overview: Under the pretext of having to make a psychological assessment, Susanne lies in to confront her ex-husband Bjørn, who is in prison after murdering Frank, who Bjørn thought was their daughter's killer.

videos.title: The Strip Club
videos.overview: Susanne finds Sapphire at the strip club and finds out she knows the suspected hitman John. But Sapphire is not only a witness - she is also a target.

videos.title: The Tracker
videos.overview: Susanne desperately needs help finding the girl and contacts CC, a former soldier she has had in therapy for PTSD. Reluctantly, he agrees to track down the girl.

videos.title: The Train
videos.overview: At the train station, Susanne sees her former colleague Maja and discovers that Maja has had a session with Sapphire and that she is connected to both the Police Commissioner and John.

videos.title: The Secret Place
videos.overview: John kidnaps Susanne and takes her and Sapphire to a deserted island in the harbor. Bound and in mortal danger, Susanne must use all her psychological abilities to survive.

videos.title: The Restaurant
videos.overview: Holger Lang receives a video recording of Christina, his protege and potential heir, being murdered. Holger immediately understands the connection to his beloved younger brother, Markus.

videos.title: The Apartment
videos.overview: Holger hurries to Markus's apartment to find Liz, the trusted and loyal company lawyer. Holger discovers that Liz helped Markus with a specific contract which could severely damage the company.

videos.title: The Construction Site
videos.overview: Holger discovers that beneath the friendly chit-chat with Otto lies a cynical quid pro quo. He continues to expose Otto's hypocrisy, only to find that he himself has let his old friend down.

videos.title: Lang Towers
videos.overview: Holger crashes a meeting headed by his younger step siblings, would-be executives Rupert and his twin sister, Beatrice. Holger confronts them with their plan to oust him.

videos.title: The Pub
videos.overview: Holger is rushing out to Markus's secret appointment when he is stopped by the police commissioner, Richard. He wants to talk to Markus as he knew John, the hitman who murdered Christina.

videos.title: The Golf Club
videos.overview: Holger goes to meet Mallstrom, his rival, and forces himself on board his helicopter. Mallstrom confesses to scheming to collapse Lang Enterprises, but he has no idea what else Markus was up to.

videos.title: The Kingdom
videos.overview: Holger wants to see Markus one last time. His first wife, Camilla, works as a doctor at the National Hospital, and he tries to convince her to give him access to the morgue.

videos.title: The Family Mansion
videos.overview: When Holger visits the family mansion, his mother, Elisabeth, is angry with him for coming there instead of turning himself in. She proves her innocence to Holger - but then he makes a surprising discovery.
